headline: New York bans AI chatbot toys for five years
summary: New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed a five-year ban on AI chatbot toys, backed by $15,000 daily fines, covering talking stuffed animals, dolls and internet-connected conversational toys. The state attorney general said she would enforce it, and the ban follows research reporting safety failures including exposure to inappropriate content.
